mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals imminent monetary policy easing, triggering positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as investors anticipate economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls exceeding 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100) indicate accelerating labor market strength, driving immediate positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through elevated consumer spending and corporate hiring.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 5% (UNRATE < 5%) signals a tight labor market that supports sustained consumer spending and corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 5%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600,000 units (HOUST > 600) indicate robust residential sector growth, boosting consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 600, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signal ineffective monetary policy during economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% AND INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery (UNRATE > 8% and FEDFUNDS < 1%), a monthly payroll increase above 100,000 (PAYEMS > 100) accelerates economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances within post-recession recovery regime (UNRATE > 8% and FEDFUNDS < 1%) when PAYEMS > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) indicates severe economic contraction, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
